explanation: The downstream outcome shows every priority row has upstream_rank 0 even though evidence_sources contains ranks 1-8. This is caused by the upstream evidence_sources handoff using source IDs as record_id values (s01, s02, etc.) instead of the retained demand record IDs (n06-r01, n06-r02, etc.), so Job 2 cannot join provenance ranks back to coverage records. The captured upstream assemble_provenance function is the supported localization because it explicitly sets 'record_id' to record.get('source_id', '').
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources has record_id values s01 through s08 while needs/coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed priorities all have upstream_rank: 0 despite evidence_sources providing rank values 1 through 8.

Captured source for job_upstream_demand_provenance assemble_provenance appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record identity with source_id.
Behavioral criteria require preserving record identities and upstream-to-downstream handoffs, and ranking by upstream provenance order.
